title: Ten-digit phone pattern
prompt:
Write one JavaScript regular expression and nothing else for a 10-digit phone number.

Accept 555-010-1234, (555) 010-1234, and 5550101234. Reject 123, 555-010, abc-def-ghij, and 555-010-12345. Anchors are required. Do not call eval. Keep the answer under 50 words.
constraints: Accepts the three phone formats and rejects shorter or longer ones
Under 50 words and does not call eval
